title: mcp servers / Choose a server to try
content: ## Choose a server to try For a concrete local example, use the [Playwright MCP server](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp). It requires **Node.js 18 or newer**, with `npx` available. Check your installation in a terminal: ```bash node --version npx --version ``` The walkthrough uses Playwright to demonstrate connecting an external tool provider. For everyday browser interaction, try the [built-in browser tools](/docs/agents/run/browser-tools.md) first: they don't require an MCP server. To try a remote documentation server instead, follow the [Context7 setup requirements](https://context7.com/docs/resources/all-clients) for its current authentication requirements and service limits. Use the HTTP endpoint `https://mcp.context7.com/mcp` in the connection steps below. A remote server doesn't require a local Node.js installation.
